reason: Hypothesis A proposes a physically sound mechanism (Hf-induced lattice distortion reducing Cr/V diffusion) consistent with the known behavior of refractory HEAs, specifies a testable composition range (4–8 at% Hf), and directly addresses the precipitate issue at 8 dpa and 1073 K using prior evidence from the same alloy system. Hypothesis B cites an unsupported precipitate density value (0.03 nm⁻²) and relies on evidence from Ni-based FCC alloys, which is not directly relevant to the W-based BCC system, making it less grounded and specific.
